newsitem.title: USA: Ex-Fed Gov Laware sees no rate hike at Sept FOMC.
newsitem.headline: Ex-Fed Gov Laware sees no rate hike at Sept FOMC.

text.p: Former Federal Reserve Board Governor John Laware said he expected no increase in U.S. short-term interest rates at the next Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meeting on September 24.
"There will be a good debate and they'll have some more information by then, but unless it changes dramatically from where it is now, I would think they would hold off," he said.
Laware, chairman of the Alliance for the Commonwealth, which promotes the export sector of the Massachusetts economy, spoke to Reuters in a telephone interview.
